summary: Test a selector with `flightctl get devices -l type=pos-terminal -l stage=development`, define a Fleet with spec.selector.matchLabels, apply it, then check the OverlappingSelectors condition with `flightctl get fleets/my_fleet -o json | jq ...`.
questions: How do I create a fleet with a label selector on the CLI?
How do I check for overlapping fleet selectors?
How do I preview which devices a fleet will select?

answer_card.title: Create a fleet from labels
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
flightctl get devices -l type=pos-terminal -l stage=development   # preview
```
```yaml
apiVersion: flightctl.io/v1alpha1
kind: Fleet
metadata: {name: my_fleet}
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      type: pos-terminal
      stage: development
```
```bash
flightctl apply -f my_fleet.yaml
flightctl get fleets/my_fleet -o json | jq -r '.status.conditions[] | select(.type=="OverlappingSelectors").status'   # expect False
```
